$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-bottomside-orientation-180.xml (Rule 10, D-030). Three frame facts at once and all non-default: SubstrateSide BottomSide, Orientation 180, OriginLocation UpperRight with AxisDirection DownLeft. Each alone is a transform; together they compose, and a reader that applies any one of them as a default instead of reading it produces a map that still parses and is wrong. DeviceSize differs from StepSize, so the street width is real rather than inferred.
